OKEx is a cryptocurrency exchange that operates through a centralized intermediary, so OKEx is not a decentralized finance application. OKEx is a centralized service rather than a smart contract protocol on a public blockchain.

Umbrella Network is a decentralized oracle network that supplies price data to smart contracts. Umbrella Network operates on the Ethereum public blockchain.

Grim Finance is a yield optimizer that automates yield farming strategies. Grim Finance operates on the Fantom public blockchain. Grim Finance suffered a security exploit in December 2021.
